notes.title: Update 0.6 is out!
notes.content: [p]We are happy to announce that we have released update 0.6. Here's what's changed in the game:[/p][list][*][p]Added a construction grid showing the width of the playing field. We noticed that some players may not realize that they are not using all the cells available for construction. Adding a visual grid should solve this problem.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new, medium game speed setting.[/p][/*][*][p]When trying to unlock a locked level, an info window about which level must be completed to unlock it is now displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]Now, if you don't have enough money, the prices of rooms on the construction panel are displayed in red.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted some backgrounds.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bugs that occurred when deleting full parking lots and rooms.[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly reworked the tutorial steps in accordance with player requests. The start of the game is now a little faster, with fewer guests before the first wave.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed minor localization bugs.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/12857aa1f92f085eed0d82f527322bd9403d9c93.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Meanwhile, we continue to work on a major release update that will add tourist trips from the hotel and two new levels in Europe.[/p][p]Thank you for playing Check Inn![/p][p][/p][p]As always, we invite you to our Discord server to discuss the update - [url="http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap"]http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap[/url] and to subscribe to our page on Steam - [url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/kishmish"]https://store.steampowered.com/developer/kishmish[/url][/p]

notes.title: Release has been postponed by one month
notes.content: [p]We are continuing to work actively on the game. However, implementing the planned features in the game is taking us longer than originally anticipated. We are postponing the release of a major update featuring tourist trips from the hotel, and with it the release of the game, by one month. We now plan to release it in late September or early October. The exact date will be announced a little later.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/b5086a5aaf5d9ba46cf94f4a1b01874ba10a35de.png"][/img][/p][p]Before that, we plan to release a patch that slightly speeds up the first stages of training and fixes the bugs we found. As always, we will publish a detailed list of changes along with the release of this update.[/p][p]Thank you for playing Check Inn![/p]

notes.title: Plans for the summer
notes.content: [p]This summer, in addition to various minor improvements, we plan to release a major update that will add a new mechanic to the game: [b]tourist trips from the hotel[/b]![/p][p]The idea is that at certain levels, some guests will want to go on a tourist trip to a landmark. To do this, they will have to gather at a specific place near the hotel and wait for a car or bus to arrive. These tours are organized by the hotel itself, i.e. you. When enough guests have gathered, you give the car or bus the command to depart. On a special scale in the interface, you will see how your tourists reach the destination and how they return. Of course, you can earn a good income from such tours. The vehicle that transports tourists can be upgraded. Namely, you can increase its speed and capacity. You start with a small car and end up with a spacious, comfortable bus.[/p][p]New levels will appear in the game - [b]in Reykjavik and London[/b]. These cities are very popular among tourists, so get ready to serve them all :)[/p][p]We plan to release this update by the end of the summer, along with the game's transition from early access to full release. Our future plans will depend entirely on the game's success in the coming months.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/5487ae0c24c81f19e2cfb2ca0bc91ed104fffc18.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thank you for playing [b]Check Inn[/b]![/p]

notes.title: Update 0.4 - Exterminator Logic Overhaul
notes.content:
The main new feature of today's update is the new logic of exterminators' workflow. Earlier their work was almost similar to that of maids. We tried to introduce something new. Now an exterminator needs a special chemical to clean the room from insects. It is made in the exterminator's room by the exterminator themselves. Thus, the exterminator now performs two actions: in their spare time they produce the product, and then they clean the rooms with it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/eafb07734b4aed0d88c07e55310261d24c552803.jpg[/img]
[h3]Also, we've made the following changes:[/h3]
- Now if you close the game on the game over screen, it will start from the same screen the next time you start the game
- Added a parking icon to the Cleveland waves timeline
- Fixed a bug where the construction sound could be unpaused
- Fixed words in different languages not being aligned properly on some interface buttons
- Fixed main menu appearance on “narrow” resolutions
- Now any reception appears with a facade first. The facade is removed after the direction for the elevator shaft is selected
- Removed old UI on the edges of the free game timeline

We are planning to release another big update that will add a five-star hotel to the game along with a new level very soon. Testing is already underway, so you won't have to wait long.

Thank you for playing Check Inn!

As always, we invite you to our Discord server to discuss the update - http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap and to subscribe to our page on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/developer/kishmish.

notes.title: Update 0.3 - New main menu and interface!
Update 0.2 - new rooms, underground parking lots, internet cafes and more
notes.content:
[b]We are glad to present to you update 0.2, which took us a little over a month to prepare.[/b]
[b]One more room for each hotel has been added to the game.[/b] We tried to make a variety of shapes to add more depth to the building process. That is, each hotel now has 6 living room types.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/d1d146387fc1801ac62b89d16ccf00e3961fcc5b.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/024a05370fe583e9a58707ad66fb5c21b7a6dd61.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/4bd4faf55ebff62677bf8d7945604cc39164f425.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/31ee50be8c06cbe87b1b8574078793b35db05de6.png[/img]
Some guests will now demand a [b]parking space[/b] for their car. To satisfy their desire, [b]you can build an underground parking lot[/b]. One cell of underground parking includes three parking spaces. Guests leave their car in the parking space and wait for the elevator on the underground floors. [b]A total of three underground floors are available for construction.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/ff29f90af91b4f082e594b4541125c63c61f7e61.png[/img]
[b]The Internet Cafe is a new service room[/b]. Guests who want to use a computer and access the internet can come here. Internet cafe can be upgraded by adding new places with computers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/b98326d8ce017a34a2f279ee758f1d94a9ad0d80.png[/img]
Due to these changes, [b]we have redesigned all the levels[/b]. Therefore, you can play again from the beginning. Or replay the levels that you liked the most. You will definitely find something new on them. The changes have also affected the balance. Among other things, we tried to reduce the cost of managers so that starting from the level in New York it would be convenient for players to hire them and not to settle all the guests manually by dragging and dropping them into the rooms. Exterminators, who are hated by some, were also rebalanced (although we have an idea about them - in one of the next updates we will change the logic of their work - it will be more interesting!).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/0697a50467015e359749d77abdc00ab189e931ce.png[/img]
[b]Building a hotel in the Free mode is now possible up to the hundredth floor![/b] Due to this, we had to make adjustments to the balance, as well as to the background. What can you expect at such a height? Try to build a tall hotel and find out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/b0b81eebca3a2f9a2cb4688ecc5ed76b38b847c1.png[/img]
[b]We have added Steam collectibles![/b]
These include badges, 10 Trading cards, 5 Emoticons and 3 profile backgrounds.

[b]In addition to that, there are a lot of small changes to the game:[/b]
- Added buttons to teleport the camera to the very bottom and the very top of the hotel. They appear on the left side of the screen when the hotel is at least 10 floors tall.
- Added new tutorial steps for presenting new features (such as building underground parking lots).
- Now if you delete a room during construction, the full cost of the room is returned.
- Fixed a bug where the room insulation window would open too high, off the screen.
- Fixed elevator checkboxes working in such a way that a checkbox is now always checked in one of the fields and you cannot uncheck it, leaving all fields empty.
- Fixed a bug when upon changing screen resolution, all guests fit on the waiting panel, but the scroll arrow still remained in place.
- Increased the maximum possible number of porters to 12.
- Fixed a bug in Montreal that occurred if you reached the second wave without buying service rooms and waited for the message that they should be bought, and then restarted the game so that the wave start window would appear afterwards.
- Other minor fixes.

Since the changes are significant, we had to remove progress within levels. However, global progress (information about which levels have been completed) will remain untouched. We hope you understand that this is a forced measure due to the redesign of all levels.

We wish you a pleasant game!

As always, we invite you to our Discord server to discuss the update - http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap and to subscribe to our page on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/developer/kishmish.

notes.title: Preparing the next big update
notes.content:
Right now we are busy preparing the next big updates for the game. Let us tell you more about what to expect in the game in the next month.

[b]We have decided to expand the construction area horizontally by four cells and add two new rooms for each of the hotels.[/b]

A new room will be added - an [b]internet cafe[/b]. You will be able to upgrade it by adding new spaces with computers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/b4c0c77077bbd64da3049ae1f869f9a915495ba1.png[/img]
Some guests will require a parking space for their car. [b]Underground parking lots[/b] will serve for this purpose. [b]The hotel can now be expanded three floors down[/b], but only parking spaces can be built underground. The load on the elevators will increase, because now they will have to deliver guests not only from the reception, but also from the parking lots.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/d99b11edb2ebbeacd94676cbe3cdf92ad91171ae.png[/img]
We are also [b]expanding the construction of the hotel all the way up to the 100th floor in Free Game[/b]. We will try to make sure that the background is also not monotonous. At high altitude you will meet some interesting surprises :) We plan to rename this mode to [b]“Quick Play”[/b] and also add a [b]“Sandbox”[/b] mode soon. But more on that later.

In the meantime, our artist is working on [b]redrawing the interface elements[/b]. It will become more convenient and more pleasant to the eye. Moreover, the changes will affect not only the existing elements, but also a new layout of the main menu will be added. You can take a look at our preliminary progress on the screenshots. Please, let us know your opinion - it is very important for us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/f34521df42627d7b99f753195fc9de602e82a3ec.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/9fb3eb706b4e2999ca97d599df4c1ae5e5b199ae.png[/img]
[b]When can we expect all this?[/b] We are not ready to give an exact date of the update release (it is also possible that the interface redesign will be presented in a separate standalone update), but definitely in the next month. We will try to please you as soon as possible!

Thank you again for sharing your impressions of the game with us and other players, as well as leaving your suggestions. As always, we read all messages and take them into account in our work.

notes.title: Update 0.1.3 has been released!
notes.content:
[h2]In this update we have prepared both new game features and bugfixes.[/h2]

[h3]Major changes:[/h3]
- Added active pause mode. Now you can pause the game and during this time perform necessary actions - build new rooms, improve service rooms, check in guests and so on.
- Added the ability to choose the specialization of elevators. Now each elevator can be general (by default), for staff only or for guests only
- Added the ability to hire managers in Free Play

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/ae24b9f11128155e2707fec51e1ba2717544f7ce.jpg[/img]
[h3]Other changes:[/h3]
- Added an option to stop clouds in Settings
- Added an option to change the temperature scale
- Global map is now zoomed out a bit more so that the maximum number of cities fit on the screen
- Improved overall game performance
- Changed some interface elements
- Fixed some localization bugs
- Fixed an issue where if there were two laundry rooms on neighboring floors, porters would only deliver laundry to one of them
- Fixed a bug that caused the exterminator's room to render on top of the wave indicator
- Fixed a bug where a porter would be removed immediately after pressing the cross button, rather than after agreeing to a prompt
- Fixed a bug with the sound of defrosting rooms
- Fixed a bug with restarting a Free Mode session where the game would rarely crash
- Blizzard volume is now linked to the SFX volume setting
- Fixed a bug where it was possible to start Free Mode session without selecting a difficulty
- Fixed a bug where the game speed would not slow down during the countdown that shows before a guest is missed

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/62526c12c4c71a40f329336716841054e6fce710.jpg[/img]
We are already preparing the next updates. They will include underground parking lots and a new service room - Internet Cafe.

We are also considering adding a Sandbox mode, where you can customize the game for yourself - choose parameters, for example, remove patience timers for guests, set the number of waves and their composition, and so on. What do you think about this idea? What game parameters in the settings of this mode would you like to see?

notes.title: Early access release on January 16!
notes.content:
We are less than a week away from Check Inn's release into early access. We are actively preparing for the release day and are already making plans for the first updates.

We've decided to add [b]another service room and a new role[/b] in the hotel - [b]exterminator[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/f3696cac6546acfcd94b47e3395ccc153a14dcb7.png[/img]

On some levels, after a guest has checked out, insects appear in the room. To get rid of them, you need to build an exterminator's room. In it, they prepare an insect repellent and spray it in the infested rooms. More exterminators can only be hired by building more rooms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/eae5a8717d3fc45890bc3ca540aab1efed3c0859.png[/img]

We have also started working on [b]adding underground parking lots[/b]. In the future, some guests will demand a parking space. So, we will need to make sure that the parking lot always has parking spots available. It will be possible to build three stories down underground.

We hope that you will enjoy [b]Check Inn[/b]. It is your support that will determine how many ideas we will be able to implement in this game in the updates during early access. And we have a lot of them.

notes.title: Development news: guest reviews, free mode, a separate page for the demo version
notes.content:
[h2]Today we will share information about what we are currently working on.[/h2]

But first, let us tell you about the new feature in Steam for creating separate pages for demo versions of games. They look almost the same as the pages of standalone games. We decided to give it a try, and now the Check Inn demo version has its own page:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2963670/Check_Inn_Demo/

An important feature of the demo versions presented on a separate page is the ability to write reviews. Therefore, if you have already tried the demo - please leave a review there. And if you haven't tried it yet - it's the perfect time to catch up!

[b]Guest reviews of their hotel stay[/b]
We decided to add guest reviews. When a guest checks out of the hotel, they leave a review of the hotel, giving it a rating on a five-point scale. Their rating is taken into account in the overall rating of the hotel, which can be seen at any time. When calculating the rating, various parameters are taken into account: the speed of their check-in, how quickly they got to the room by elevator, the speed of service (such as sauna, food delivery and laundry), the temperature in the room during their stay (on levels with variable temperature). It will be possible to open a separate window and read text reviews, which in some cases will help you understand what you need to pay attention to when developing the hotel. At the end of the level, this final rating will be used in the leaderboard as the player's main competitive indicator, that is, it will serve as a multiplier to all the other parameters when counting up your total score.

[b]Free mode[/b]
We are working on a special mode that will be perfect for players who like long gaming sessions. Here you will be able to choose the difficulty level, hotel star rating and background that suits you. However, hotels and backgrounds in free mode are unlocked by completing regular levels. You will be able to compete with other players for a place in the leaderboard. Moreover, the higher the difficulty level, the more opportunities you have to score more points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/f7d462db03b49f2aee9a355b03904cb9e5cd5533.png[/img]

As you can see, we are continuing development at the same active pace. There is not much time left before the game is released in early access. And we will announce the exact release date of the game soon in a separate post. So, stay tuned!

notes.title: Demo update - we added service rooms!
notes.content:
The update is really important, so those who have already completed the demo are invited to play again. The gameplay really feels different now.

The most important thing is that we have added [i][b]service rooms[/b][/i]. That is, any guest who stays at the hotel for more than 3 nights may want:
[list]
[*] Food delivery from [i][b]the kitchen[/b][/i] to their room. Accordingly, the hotel must have at least one [i][b]kitchen[/b][/i].
[*] Washing their dirty clothes. In this case, the guest leaves a basket with dirty clothes in the hallway, and [i][b]the porter[/b][/i] must take it to [i][b]the laundry[/b][/i]. There, the clothes are loaded into the washing machine (or machines). When the washing is finished, [i][b]the porter[/b][/i] takes the clean clothes back to the room.
[*] Take a steam bath in [b][i]the sauna[/i][/b]. The guest themselves goes by elevator to the floor where the sauna is located and occupies one of the rooms in it for a while. One room - one guest.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/bb3c1542d71fc5f5d9827cf1ae33f2f1fe56485c.jpg[/img]
As you can see, a new important role has been added to the hotel - [i][b]the porter[/b][/i]. They can carry two items on their carts: food, dirty or clean laundry. If you see that one [i][b]porter[/b][/i] can no longer cope with the delivery, you can hire a few more.

Each of the [i][b]service rooms[/b][/i] can be upgraded. For example, in [i][b]the kitchen[/b][/i], you can increase the speed of cooking, their quality, capacity (affects the number of ready meals that [i][b]the porter[/b][/i] can pick up at any time).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/c8d2fc12d54a6859afad9caa3c352c75204360a3.jpg[/img]
We also added the ability to [i][b]zoom the camera[/b][/i] in and out. This can be done using the mouse wheel. And you can now move the camera to the side using the arrows on the keyboard or the WASD keys.
Due to the mentioned changes, the entire demo version level has undergone a serious rebalance. Please let us know about your opinion on this update. Did you like the fact that the gameplay in the game is becoming more profound? As always, we read all messages and try to respond to them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/585508a133fab587e658bd07b337c63ff2dda892.jpg[/img]
We remind you that the best way not to miss the release of the game is to add it to your Wishlist. This way, you will receive a message by email at the time of release.

notes.title: Serve your guests - build kitchens, laundries, saunas and other utility rooms!
notes.content:
We continue to actively develop the game. Moreover, we are not only working on creating new levels, but also thinking about how to make the game as a whole even more interesting and diverse.
So, checking a guest into a hotel will be only the first step. During their stay, they will request various services: wash their clothes, order food, go to a sauna, and so on. All this will require creating appropriate rooms, as well as hiring new employees: porters. They will carry food, linen and other things between rooms and floors of the hotel.

Let's take a closer look at what will soon appear in the demo version update.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/45b9b5760d6b38e47ec567c091c1c180fc017949.png[/img]
[b]Kitchen[/b]
Various dishes are prepared here. Moreover, we can improve the kitchen to make more expensive dishes, and the cooking process will go faster. Ready dishes are laid out on the countertop and await delivery to the guest’s room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/964eab2208de65b1f84f23cb231e55aa2514cab5.png[/img]
[b]Laundry[/b]
If a guest wants to wash their clothes, they put a basket in the hallway. The porter should pick it up and take it to the laundry, where these clothes are put into the washing machine. When the washing is done, we can see clean clothes on the shelves. The porter then delivers them back to the room.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/758a41fef8ff56fc814517402365aba3d73c48d7.png[/img]
[b]Sauna[/b]
In fact, this room is not just a sauna, but a passage to private sauna rooms. That is, you can buy new rooms here (up to 5 of them). The guest goes down or up from his floor to the sauna to take a steam bath. The process itself takes some time. If all the saunas are occupied, then the guests stand in line.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/660a3a0e4887665abe1f684d7f064770944b97dd.png[/img]
[b]Porters[/b]
This is a new type of employee. Their main task is to carry items for serving guests. Each porter has a cart that can fit two items: linen, a dish, and so on. If you see that one porter does not have time to deliver everything on time, then it is worth hiring another one.

How do you like this idea? Soon you will be able to try it out for yourself in an updated demo version. We will announce this in a separate post. So, stay tuned and subscribe to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/9eHyYap]Discord[/url] and [url=https://x.com/KishMishStudio]Twitter[/url] (yes, we still call it that). And if you haven't added the game to your wishlist yet, we recommend doing so as not to miss the release!

notes.title: Development news - we made a level with freezing rooms!
notes.content:
We continue to work on the levels in Check Inn, and we're trying to make them diverse. For example, in Montreal and other locations with cold winters, you will have to control the temperature.

[previewyoutube=bpNHBgtyw0k;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/b6a9efcc6afae7c2a9d5ba51a006b9e5000e2528.png[/img]
When the temperature outside drops below certain levels, uninsulated rooms will freeze. New guests cannot be accommodated in a frozen room, and those who lived there continue their stay, while their timer is also “frozen”. Therefore, you need to insulate your rooms. There are several options for insulation - from simple to robust, designed for the lowest temperatures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/127866cbfcf2056c52852da856160444739a10ab.png[/img]
Don't forget to add the game to your wishlist if you haven't already, and we, in turn, will continue to talk about the progress of development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/ea664766c1932f17dd85e4e40d1ed691ed95b17e.png[/img]
As always, we invite you to our Discord server to discuss the news - http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap and to subscribe to our page on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/developer/kishmish.

notes.title: We updated the Demo!
notes.content:
The most important new feature is balconies instead of terraces. They can only be built at one of the edges of the hotel. That is, there are no more rooms that would block the entire column of cells vertically, making further construction on it impossible.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/b2aa035d8ed0c0ed24b9e14af8fd1fafccdf5cb5.png[/img]

Now the elevators are upgraded gradually, little by little. You can choose which of the elevator specifications to improve - speed or capacity. The ability to improve elevators opens only after the appropriate step in training.

Also, the room icon on the guest wish panel turns green if there is currently a free room of this type. That is, now you don’t have to select a guest to see if there is a suitable room. This is especially convenient when the hotel is already pretty tall.

It is still important for us to hear your opinion about the demo. Please let us know what you liked and what you didn't like.

As always, we invite you to our Discord server to discuss the update - http://discord.gg/invite/9eHyYap and to subscribe to our page on Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/developer/kishmish.

notes.title: Development news - join our Discord server!
notes.content:
The development of Check Inn is underway, and we will be happy to share news with you. We have created a separate channel for Check Inn on our Discord server, where we will publish development news. There you can join the chat and discuss your questions regarding the game. Come in, we'll be glad to see you there :) Link: https://discord.com/invite/9eHyYap 

The most important news of the previous week is the change in the concept of rooms with terraces. We decided that the current implementation did not capture the potential of the core game mechanics well. Now instead of rooms with terraces there will be balconies. A room with a balcony can be placed at the left or right side of the hotel so that the cell with the balcony is “in the air”. The shape of such rooms is more complex than regular ones, but you can also get more money for a guest staying in them. There will be no more situations when nothing can be built over them anymore. However, rooms with terraces will also not disappear without a trace and we are going to use them on one of the special levels. By the way, one of the players suggested the idea of ​​balconies, and we picked it up and implemented it in the game.

Over the next week, we will try to update the demo version of the game so that you can evaluate the updated logic for constructing such rooms. At the same time, you will be able to see gradual improvements in elevators. Now the speed of the elevator and its capacity are pumped separately and a little at a time, at a lower cost than before. This way, you will have more control over them and you will be able to choose what is best to spend your money on at the current time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44888383/c635f1f0c5ff6076626cd4bfd06c2c07e4d3d141.png[/img]

We present to your attention the first screenshot from a 4-star hotel. As you can see, the forms of numbers are much more complex; in particular, there are no single-cell numbers that can be used to “plug” unnecessary spaces. At this level, like in chess, you have to think several steps ahead, preparing in advance the conditions for the location of future numbers. The reception and elevator shaft that are visible in the screenshot are temporarily taken from another hotel.
